I couldn't confirm the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co., and I said so in a thread reply to Pree's message in #central-team.

What I checked was what Pree can see herself: the public files and the #central-team history. None of it mentions Brackenwater, and there's no contract or CRM record for it. So the date is still unverified hearsay, and I didn't record it anywhere. I suggested she ask the account owner or June (deal desk) to check it against the signed contract or order form.

Nothing needed approval: a renewal date counts as an operational fact, not a finance figure, and I sent no mail.
